title: A Message about a Club Meeting
instructions: Write your own first draft, submit it, and use the feedback to correct your expression.
prompt: Write 100–140 words to a real or imagined club member. Explain when and where to meet, one activity, one polite request, and what to do if the person is busy. Give a reason for at least one suggestion.

guidedOutput.title: 结构提示与例文
guidedOutput.text:
Useful frames:
Let us meet ...
Please bring ... because ...
Can you ... please?
If you are busy, ...

Example (use your own details):
Hi Nora, thank you for joining our English club. We can meet in Room 5 on Wednesday morning. Please bring your notebook because we will write short questions together. Can you tell me your favorite subject, please? We can talk about math or another subject. If you are busy at work, send me a message and we can choose another time. I will wait near the door to help you find our group. After we finish, we can review one useful question. See you on Wednesday!
